def parse_grid(text):
    lines = text.strip().split('\n')
    grid = [[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in lines]
    return grid

def apply_rule(grid, background=7, pattern=3):
    """For each row with pattern values, change background values to the right of last pattern into 1s"""
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(len(result)):
        # Find positions of pattern color
        pattern_positions = [j for j in range(len(result[i])) if result[i][j] == pattern]
        if pattern_positions:
            # Find the rightmost pattern
            last_pattern_col = max(pattern_positions)
            # Change background to the right of last pattern into 1s
            for j in range(last_pattern_col + 1, len(result[i])):
                if result[i][j] == background:
                    result[i][j] = 1
    return result

test_in = parse_grid(test_input_str)
test_out = apply_rule(test_in, background=7, pattern=3)

import json
print(json.dumps(test_out))

    # Find all pattern elements
